title: Web Image Bridge v0.1 contract bundle
description: Canonical JSON Schema definitions; the root validates a tool/direction/payload fixture wrapper, not JSON-RPC framing

local_path.description: Windows drive-absolute syntax only; canonicalization, opened-file identity and allowed roots are application checks

x-state-model.same_state_update: Only a meaningful snapshot change increments revision
x-state-model.unknown_recovery: No transition to not_sent; reconciliation may only attach existing submission evidence

x-policy.tombstone_retention: No automatic expiry; explicit complete app-data reset breaks historical deduplication
x-policy.submit_replay: Return original job_id and current snapshot without re-reading source files
x-policy.command_replay: Return original outcome plus current snapshot; do not reapply effects
x-policy.export_replay: Return current receipt; resume pending or failed copies only, never overwrite or regenerate
x-policy.schema_scope: Storage identity, allowed roots, same-session lineage, cursor equality and durability require application checks
